@@ -3,3 +3,12 @@
 All money is handled as whole cents.
 
 Discounts are a whole-number percent of the order subtotal.
+
+## Example
+
+A subtotal of 200 cents with a 10% discount:
+
+- Discount: 200 × 10 / 100 = 20 cents
+- Total: 200 − 20 = 180 cents
+
+The discount is rounded down to whole cents (`Math.floor`), so any fraction of a cent stays in the total.
